anchor: v4::Ines Carvalho. The Basecamp 6 tent from ORD-20731 was crushed in shipping, two poles are bent. I want my money back.

result.text: I'm sorry the Basecamp 6 tent arrived crushed with bent poles. Because the tent is valued at $480, a human agent needs to review this damage claim before any refund can be issued, so I've escalated it as ticket ESC-4107. I can't promise a refund amount or timing until that review is complete, and the agent should respond within 1 business day.

output.explanation: Damage claims of $200 or more need review by a human agent. Escalate with category "damage_claim" and do not promise a refund.

input.summary: Customer Ines Carvalho (C-1027) reports the Basecamp 6 tent ($480, delivered 2026-09-30, unopened) arrived crushed in shipping with two bent poles, and she wants a refund. Damage claim of $200 or more requires human review, so the return was not created.
